name: The Ritz-Carlton, Half Moon Bay
insider_take: Perched on dramatic bluffs overlooking the Pacific, this coastal gem offers championship golf and world-class luxury just 28 miles from San Francisco.
whats_special: The hotel sits on 261 acres of pristine coastline featuring two championship golf courses designed by Arthur Hills. Half Moon Bay is famous for producing 99% of the world's Brussels sprouts and hosts the annual World Championship Pumpkin Weigh-Off, where record-breaking giant pumpkins can exceed 2,000 pounds.
pro_tip: Visit during October for the Half Moon Bay Art & Pumpkin Festival - book early as it's one of California's most popular fall events, drawing over 300,000 visitors annually.
dont_miss: The nearby Mavericks surf break produces some of the world's most dangerous waves (up to 60 feet tall), and the historic Pigeon Point Lighthouse, one of the tallest lighthouses on the West Coast at 115 feet, offers breathtaking sunset views just 20 minutes south.
pros: Dramatic clifftop location with panoramic Pacific Ocean views
Two championship golf courses including Ocean Colony Golf Course
Award-winning Navio restaurant featuring coastal California cuisine
Luxury spa with ocean-inspired treatments and coastal wellness experiences
cons: Remote coastal location requires driving to nearby attractions
Premium pricing reflects luxury positioning and exclusive amenities
